outcomes.name: The vision has been refined based on pilot learnings
The vision is understood across every site/team joining the scaled rollout

actions.action: Review feedback from the pilot to identify what worked well and what needs to change in the vision before scaling.
Refine the vision statement to reflect lessons learned from the pilot and the needs of the wider rollout.
Secure sponsor endorsement of the refined vision for the scaled rollout.
Ensure the refined vision is consistently communicated to leaders as new sites/teams join the rollout.
Continuously validate that the vision remains relevant as the change scales across the organisation.
Gather feedback from pilot participants on how well the vision resonated with them.
Adapt the communication approaches that worked in the pilot for a wider, more diverse audience.
Deliver vision communications to stakeholders in newly onboarding sites/teams.
Monitor understanding of the vision among stakeholders in the wider rollout and address gaps.
Use champions from the pilot to help new sites/teams connect with the vision.
